steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable name Random Number
2. Assign a random number from 1 to 10 to the variable Random Number
3. Display the variable Random Number on the LCD for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Use random number block

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable name Random Number
2. Assign a random number from 1 to 10 to the variable Random Number
3. Display the variable Random Number on the top row of the LCD
4. When the Random Number value is less than 5, display "Less than 5" on the LCD screen
5. Display the above texts for 2 seconds.
